role: Request-time output filter for LLM assistant replies: rewrites any sentence matching a MedicalTermLexicon concept (diagnosis, referral, AFib, overtraining, cure, etc.) or an OffensiveTermLexicon slur/sexual term into a neutral localized deflection, and provides the sentence-segmentation helpers the streaming buffer uses to hold back incomplete sentences.
types: CoachVoiceGuard: enum — namespace for scrub rules, deflection copy, sentence splitting and the scrub/containsProhibitedLanguage API
CoachVoiceGuard.Rule: struct — a MedicalTermLexicon.Concept plus audit reason; deflection resolved at read time
CoachVoiceGuard.Result: struct — scrubbed text + triggers audit list + didIntercept flag
OffensiveTermLexicon: enum — English slur/explicit-term concepts (every-reply list and English-only list) and NLLanguageRecognizer-based reply-language gate
toplevel: Static lets are lazily initialised on first access: rules maps MedicalTermLexicon.scrubFromOutput to Rule(reason 'Coach output: <id>.'); medicalEntries/offensiveEntry/englishOnlyOffensiveEntry compile each rule via MedicalTermLexicon.regex(for:) and compactMap drops any concept whose pattern fails to compile (silently removed from the perimeter except for a DebugLogger signal inside regex). everyReplyEntries = medical entries then the offensive entry. Callers: AssistantViewModel+Context.swift:575 (stream flush), AssistantViewModel+Routing.swift:717 (post-stream whole message), VoiceConversationController+Speech.swift:688 (every spoken utterance), VoiceConversationController+Control.swift:312 (interjection text).

Rule.deflection: returns the localized replacement sentence for this rule's concept by calling CoachVoiceGuard.deflection(for:) at each read, so it follows a mid-session language change.
Maps a concept id to its replacement sentence: offensive concept ids get offensiveDeflection, otherwise the deflections dictionary entry, else observationFallback.

flags.text: Comment says a lexicon concept without a deflection is a 'compile-time-visible omission rather than a silent pass-through' and that testEveryScrubbedConceptHasARule asserts the mapping is total, but that test only compares CoachVoiceGuard.rules (built by mapping scrubFromOutput itself, so tautological) and testDeflectionsCoverExactlyTheScrubbedConcepts checks only deflection keys -> scrubbed ids. A new scrubFromOutput concept with no deflection silently gets observationFallback via ??; nothing fails. All 21 current concepts are mapped (6 specific + 3 verdict + 12 shared).

Compiles a rule's concept into an NSRegularExpression via MedicalTermLexicon.regex(for:) and pairs it with the rule; nil when the pattern fails to compile (rule then dropped by the callers' compactMap).

flags.text: A concept whose pattern fails to compile is dropped from medicalEntries/offensiveEntry via compactMap, silently removing that term from the output perimeter at runtime; only tests (testEveryConceptCompiles) and a DebugLogger path in the shared compiler notice.

units.does: Chooses the active rule set for a text: everyReplyEntries, plus the English-only offensive entry when that entry matches the text AND the reply is judged English (recognizer or app language).

branches.cond: englishOnlyOffensiveEntry compiled AND matches text AND appliesToReply(text, app language) is true
branches.effect: true: return everyReplyEntries + [englishOnly]; any condition false: return everyReplyEntries only (the language recognizer is never run when the English-only term does not appear)

units.does: Result.didIntercept: true when triggers is non-empty.

Scrubs a reply: selects active rules, returns the input unchanged if empty or no rule matches anywhere; otherwise splits into sentence segments, replaces each matching segment's core with its rule's deflection while collecting (reason, sentence) triggers; if no single segment matched, delegates to deflectStraddlingMatch; else returns tidy(rebuilt) plus triggers. Called from AssistantViewModel+Context.swift:576, AssistantViewModel+Routing.swift:718, VoiceConversationController+Speech.swift:689, VoiceConversationController+Control.swift:312 and tests.

branches.cond: output is empty OR no active rule matches the whole text (incl. emphasis-stripped)
branches.effect: true: return Result(scrubbed: output, triggers: []) unchanged; false: continue with per-sentence rewrite
rewrite appends either the original segment or its deflected form

branches.cond: triggers is empty after per-sentence pass (whole text matched but no single sentence did)
branches.effect: true: return deflectStraddlingMatch(...) (partial or whole-message deflection); false: return tidy(rebuilt) with triggers

flags.text: Doc says sentences that match nothing are returned byte-identical, whitespace included, but tidy() is applied to the whole rebuilt string, so every double space, ' .' and ' ,' in untouched sentences is also rewritten (e.g. 4-space markdown indentation in a clean sentence becomes 2 spaces) whenever any one sentence is deflected.

units.does: Handles a match that spans a sentence boundary: logs an error, re-runs the matching regex on the original text, replaces all segments overlapping the match with one deflection, and returns that tidied text if no rule matches it any more; otherwise (no raw match, e.g. matched only after emphasis stripping, no overlap, or residual match) returns just the deflection as the whole message with the full output as the trigger.

branches.cond: raw regex match found on original text AND its range converts AND replacing() returns non-nil AND rebuilt text has no remaining match
branches.effect: true: Result(tidy(rebuilt), trigger = matched substring); false: fail closed — Result(scrubbed: entire reply replaced by the rule's deflection, trigger = whole output)

units.does: Rebuilds the text from segments, keeping segments that do not overlap the matched range and emitting the deflection once in place of the first overlapping segment (later overlapping segments dropped); returns nil if no segment overlapped.

branches.effect: examined in order

branches.effect: true: append segment unchanged and continue; false: fall through to replacement

flags.text:
'
' is a sentence terminator, so in streaming a prohibited phrase wrapped across a newline (the 'see a
doctor' case deflectStraddlingMatch exists for) is split by splitAtLastSentenceBoundary: StreamTextBuffer scrubs and publishes 'see a
' (no match) before 'doctor' arrives, so the phrase is rendered and the speakable cursor advances past it; only the post-stream whole-message pass (AssistantViewModel+Routing.swift:717) rewrites it afterwards. The straddle tests only cover whole-text scrub, and the streaming test has no newline straddle.

units.does: Returns true when the English-only offensive list should apply: if the recognizer is confident about the reply's language, whether that is English; otherwise whether the in-app language code is English.

branches.effect: true: return detected == .english; false: return appLanguage == .english

units.does: Runs NLLanguageRecognizer on text with at least 3 whitespace-separated words and returns the top hypothesis if its probability is ≥ 0.6, else nil.
